title: RNA Isolation from QIAzol Sample with miRNeasy Mini Kit
author: Stephan Schreiber
materials: Preheat the ThermoMixer with 0.5 mL block and ThermoTop at 37 °C .
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
At this time, preheat the ThermoMixer with 1.5 mL block and ThermoTop at 58 °C .
Clean all used materials and put them back.

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample in QIAzol reagent.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube containing the sample (cell pellets or homogenized tissue in QIAzol reagent) on the bench top at room temperature (15-25 °C) for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge the MaXtract tube at 14,000 x g for 30 seconds.
Mix QIAzol-sample by pipetting or another appropriate homogenization method.
Transfer 1000 µL of QIAzol-sample to the MaXtract® tube.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the aqueous phase using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL chloroform.
Securely cap the tube and shake vigorously for 15 seconds (DO NOT VORTEX).
Place the tube on the bench top at room temperature for 3 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g at 4 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind RNA to the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Label spin columns and 1.5 mL SafeLockTubes for ethanol mixture and elution; prepare Buffer RWT and Buffer RPE if necessary.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase from the Maxtract tube to a new 1.5 mL safe-lock tube by decanting.
Add 750 µL (approx. 1.5 volumes) of 100% (v/v) ethanol and mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Pipet 700 µL of the sample, including any precipitate, into an RNeasy Mini spin column in a 2 mL collection tube.
Close the lid and centrifuge at room temperature at 8,000 x g for 30 seconds, then discard the flow-through.
Repeat the loading and centrifugation step with the remainder of the sample.

steps.title: Column Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the spin column to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL Buffer RWT to the spin column, centrifuge for 30 seconds at 8,000 x g, and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 µL Buffer RPE to the spin column, centrifuge for 30 seconds at 8,000 x g, and discard the flow-through.
Add another 500 µL Buffer RPE to the spin column, centrifuge for 2 minutes at 8,000 x g, and discard the flow-through.
Place the spin column into a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 1 minute to further dry the membrane.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the total RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new 1.5 mL SafeLockTube.
Pipet 30 µL RNase-free water directly onto the spin column membrane.
Close the lid and centrifuge for 1 minute at 8,000 x g to elute.
Remove and discard spin columns and place elution tubes with total RNA on ice.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the RNA sample using Turbo DNase.

substeps.instruction: Prepare and label 0.5 mL SafeLockTubes.
Add 3 µL 10x Turbo DNase Buffer and 1.5 µL Turbo DNase to the samples.
Transfer samples to 0.5 mL SafeLockTubes and mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate samples for 30 minutes at 37 °C.
Add another 1.5 µL Turbo DNase, mix by pipetting, and incubate for another 30 minutes at 37 °C.
Prepare and label 1.5 mL SafeLockTubes for digested total-RNA and thaw DNase Inactivation reagent.
Add 7.2 µL of well-mixed Turbo DNase Inactivation reagent and mix by pipetting.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, mixing occasionally by vortexing at 1800 rpm.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 minute 30 seconds.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Concentrate and purify the RNA via ethanol precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer as much RNA as possible (upper aqueous phase) to 1.5 mL SafeLockTubes by pipetting, avoiding the white sediment.
Add 140 µL RNase-free water, 4 µL Glycogen, and 20 µL 3M Sodium Acetate; mix by pipetting.
Add 600 µL of ice-cold 100% ethanol to each sample and mix by pipetting.
Place samples at -20 °C overnight.

steps.title: RNA Recovery and Washing
steps.instruction: Recover the RNA pellet and wash with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Pre-cool the centrifuge to 4 °C.
Centrifuge samples at 12,000 x g at 4 °C for 30 minutes.
Wash the pellet with 500 µL ice-cold 70% (v/v) ethanol and vortex briefly.
Centrifuge samples at 7,600 x g at 4 °C for 5 minutes.
Wash the pellet with another 500 µL ice-cold 70% (v/v) ethanol and vortex briefly.
Centrifuge samples at 7,600 x g at 4 °C for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge samples at 7,600 x g at 4 °C for 30 seconds.
Carefully remove and discard any remaining ethanol by pipetting.

steps.title: Final Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Dissolve the RNA pellet and store.

substeps.instruction: Allow the pellet to air dry at room temperature under the PCR workbench with the tube lid open (do not overdry).
Dissolve the pellet in 20 µL of RNase-free water by pipetting up and down.
Incubate samples for 8 minutes at 58 °C in a ThermoMixer.
Place samples on ice to cool down, mix by flicking, and centrifuge briefly.
Store total RNA at -80 °C.
Empty all waste bins and discard flow-through collections.
Clean all used working areas with RNaseAWAY.
Turn off all used instruments.
Turn on the PCR workbench UV light for 30 minutes.
